newsitem.title: POLAND: POLES GROW FONDER OF THEIR BEER - SURVEY.
newsitem.headline: POLES GROW FONDER OF THEIR BEER - SURVEY.

text.p: More and more Poles prefer Polish beer above imported brands, an independent Pentor polling institute said on Thursday.
Accoridng to the survey 56 percent of Poles like domestic brews best, up from 53 percent in 1995 and 44 percent in 1992.
Pentor said that 62 percent of the 6,024 households surveyed purchased beer regularly and that 87 percent of the consumers only bought Polish beers.

Consumers said Zaklady Piwowarskie w Zywcu SA (Zywiec) Zywiec produced the best tasting domestic brew, followed by Elbrewery Company Ltd (EB) and Okocimskie Zaklady Piwowarskie SA (Okocim) , Pentor said.
Pentor said during the January-October period 14.3 million hectolitres of beer were sold on Poland, up 8.8 percent from the corresponding period of last year.
